dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: Hehe... Harder than it looks nowadays! And who'd sell you fishing supplies if I were to pack it up and go?

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: It's not like I'm starving and destitute. We'll get by somehow. Fishing is about the fishing, not the fish, and life is about living, not just existing...

dialogues.speaker: Zherebtsov
dialogues.text: Err, what I mean to say is that both fish and life are better well-done.
